request: Hey Claude, I just added the "ad-creative-fatigue-detector" skill. Check my Google Ads ads for creative fatigue. Which ones are wearing out, and what should I rotate?

account.business: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm

window.rule: 24 complete Monday-to-Sunday weeks for Google Ads, as six 4-week periods

assumptions.prospecting_or_retargeting: not used on Search (no frequency); exposure comes from ad age

data_pulled.call: gaql: ad_group_ad by segments.month, 24 months (ad age)
gaql: enabled ads in enabled ad groups and campaigns

note: Real run on 2026-10-06 on a client Google Ads account, anonymised: the business, attorney, firm and state names, campaign and ad group names, and every id are replaced; ads are numbered by impressions; spend is rounded to the nearest $10, cost per click to whole dollars. Data was pulled by the skill through the InsightfulPipe MCP; nothing was pasted. Only Google Ads is in this sample: the Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat and X calls were tested on our own accounts, which had no delivery in the window.
